intent: Individually distinguish almost every body part, head still while measuring helmet, cold water onto face, hair tied before cooking, one closed eye, puppy black ear, rain on nose and covering mouth when coughing.

workshop.title: 部位、数量和先后，逐处找证据
workshop.instruction: 改一个条件，看解释怎样变化；图片认部位，句子定含义。

transfer.stem: 换成车窗、包和树叶，哪组三句完整保留了信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
我擦车窗时，请把包拿稳。离开之前先合上包。几乎每片叶子都是湿的。
词语提示：hold 稳稳拿住；wipe 擦；leaf 叶子，复数leaves。

options.text: Hold the bag still after I wipe the window. Close the bag before leaving. Almost every leaf is wet.
Hold the bag still while I wipe the window. Close the bag after leaving. Almost every leaf is wet.
Hold the bag still while I wipe the window. Close the bag before leaving. Every leaf is wet, without exception.
Hold the bag still while I wipe the window. Close the bag before leaving. Almost every leaf is wet.

answer.display: Hold the bag still while I wipe the window. Close the bag before leaving. Almost every leaf is wet.

explanation.strategy: 逐条核对同时、先后和范围词，不把要求写成已完成。

steps.text: 擦车窗时拿稳包：Hold the bag still while I wipe the window。
steps.reason: while保留同时；after把要求推到擦完以后。

steps.text: 离开前合上包：Close the bag before leaving。
steps.reason: before不能改成after；原句不是已经合上。

steps.text: 几乎每片叶子都湿：Almost every leaf is wet。
steps.reason: almost不等于毫无例外；every后用单数leaf。

distractors.reason: without exception补出了毫无例外，丢掉almost。

explanation.pitfall: while同时、before先于、almost接近，三个限制都须保留。
